verdict.rationale: Agent Studio is a first-party, in-product AI feature. The user hands it a short use-case description and it builds a call-ready voice agent, which is a real but single-purpose form of task delegation. The Bolna MCP server is excluded because it connects external assistants (Claude, Cursor) rather than providing one built into the product. missing for 10: a general-purpose built-in assistant that accepts arbitrary tasks (e.g. editing agents, analysing calls, running batches), evidence of conversational or multi-step delegation, independent or hands-on corroboration of Agent Studio.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Agent Studio turns a short description of your use case into a production-grade, call-ready voice AI agent — in 5 to 8 minutes. No prompt engineering, no guesswork.
